Is Section 3 intended to apply to a President/Vice President candidate dying befoer the election is held,or to a Pres/VP-elect dying between the election and the start of their term?

Both situations would need to be addressed.

Also,the Amendment presumably removes the impediment to running mates from the same state...would this have consequences?
